clauses.heading:
FIRST AMENDMENT TO
SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT
clauses.text:
THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT,
dated effective as of March 27, 2019 (the "First Amendment"), is entered into by and
among EMPIRE LOUISIANA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the "Original
Borrower" or "EL") and EMPIRE NORTH DAKOTA LLC, a Delaware limited liability
company ("END", together with the Original Borrower are sometimes referred to herein
collectively as the "Borrower") and CROSSFIRST BANK, a Kansas state-chartered
bank (the "Bank").
RECITALS:
A. The Original Borrower and the Bank are parties to that certain Senior Revolver
Loan Agreement dated as of September 20, 2018 (the "Existing Loan Agreement"),
pursuant to which the Bank established a revolving credit facility in favor of the Original
Borrower in the maximum principal amount of $5,000,000.00 (subject to the Revolver
Commitment Amount (initially $1,350,000.00) and the Collateral Borrowing Base
calculation provisions hereof) until the Revolver Final Maturity Date (currently
September 20, 2020) (the "Revolver Commitment").
B. To induce the Bank to consider an increase, modification, renewal and
extension of the Existing Loan Agreement, the Original Borrower and END have
requested that END be added as a co-borrower thereto.
C. Borrower has requested, and the Bank has agreed, to increase the Revolver
Commitment until the extended Revolver Final Maturity Date (March 27, 2021) in the
increased Revolver Commitment Amount of $9,000,000.00, and make certain other
amendments and modifications, all on the terms, provisions, conditions and limitations
set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement, as amended by the provisions of this First
Amendment.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements
contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, receipt of which is
acknowledged by the parties hereto, the parties agree as follows:
clauses.plain_english:
THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT,
dated effective as of March 27, 2019 (the "First Amendment"), is entered into by and
among EMPIRE LOUISIANA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the "Original
Borrower" or "EL") and EMPIRE NORTH DAKOTA LLC, a Delaware limited liability
company ("END", together with the Original Borrower are sometimes referred to herein
collectively as the "Borrower") and CROSSFIRST BANK, a Kansas state-chartered
bank (the "Bank").
RECITALS:
A. The Original Borrower and the Bank are parties to that certain Senior Revolver
Loan Agreement dated as of September 20, 2018 (the "Existing Loan Agreement"),
pursuant to which the Bank established a revolving credit facility in favor of the Original
Borrower in the maximum principal amount of $5,000,000.00 (subject to the Revolver
Commitment Amount (initially $1,350,000.00) and the Collateral Borrowing Base
calculation provisions hereof) until the Revolver Final Maturity Date (currently
September 20, 2020) (the "Revolver Commitment").
B. To induce the Bank to consider an increase, modification, renewal and
extension of the Existing Loan Agreement, the Original Borrower and END have
requested that END be added as a co-borrower thereto.
C. Borrower has requested, and the Bank has agreed, to increase the Revolver
Commitment until the extended Revolver Final Maturity Date (March 27, 2021) in the
increased Revolver Commitment Amount of $9,000,000.00, and make certain other
amendments and modifications, all on the terms, provisions, conditions and limitations
set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement, as amended by the provisions of this First
Amendment.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements
contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, receipt of which is
acknowledged by the parties hereto, the parties agree as follows:

clauses.heading: 2.13 Quarterly Commitment Reduction (QCR). On the last day of each
clauses.text:
calendar quarter, commencing June 30, 2019, the Revolver Commitment
Amount shall automatically be reduced by $150,000.00 per quarter (the
"QCR"), and Borrower shall make any principal payment necessary to
comply with the QCR. Such principal payment shall be in addition to the
regularly scheduled interest payment.
The definition of "MCR" and all references to "MCR" in the Existing Loan Agreement are

clauses.heading: 2.14 Loan Amendment Fee. For each amendment or other change to
clauses.text: this Agreement that is required (in the sole discretion of the Bank) as a result of a change in terms or conditions requested by Borrower, Borrower shall pay Bank a fee in an amount equal to the Revolver Commitment Amount then outstanding, multiplied by twenty five basis points (0.25%), which fee shall be payable in immediately available funds concurrent with the closing of such amendment.
clauses.plain_english: If the borrower requests any change to the loan agreement, the borrower must pay the bank a fee equal to 0.25% of the outstanding revolver commitment, payable in immediately available funds when the amendment is closed.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause imposes a one-sided payment obligation on the borrower, but the fee is limited (0.25% of outstanding commitment) and is a standard provision in loan agreements, resulting in moderate risk.
obligations: Borrower shall pay Bank a fee equal to the Revolver Commitment Amount then outstanding multiplied by 0.25% in immediately available funds concurrent with the closing of such amendment.

clauses.heading: 15. SUBMISSION TO JURISDICTION. BORROWER AND THE BANK HEREBY
clauses.text: CONSENT TO THE JURISDICTION OF ANY OF THE LOCAL, STATE, AND FEDERAL COURTS LOCATED WITHIN TULSA COUNTY, OKLAHOMA AND WAIVES ANY OBJECTION WHICH THE BORROWER MAY HAVE BASED ON IMPROPER VENUE OR FORUM NON CONVENIENS TO THE CONDUCT OF ANY PROCEEDING IN ANY SUCH COURT.
clauses.plain_english: The borrower agrees that any legal disputes can be heard in Tulsa County, Oklahoma state or federal courts and gives up the right to object that the venue is improper or inconvenient.
clauses.risk_justification: Limits the borrower's procedural defenses by waiving venue objections, which is a common but one-sided provision favoring the lender; typical in loan agreements, presenting moderate risk.
obligations: Consent to jurisdiction of Tulsa County, Oklahoma state and federal courts
Waive any objection based on improper venue or forum non conveniens
rights: Bank may initiate proceedings in Tulsa County courts without borrower raising venue-based objections

clauses.heading: 16. WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL. BORROWER FULLY, VOLUNTARILY AND
clauses.text: EXPRESSLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION OR PROCEEDING TO ENFORCE OR DEFEND ANY RIGHTS UNDER THE LOAN AGREEMENT (INCLUDING THIS FIRST AMENDMENT), THE SECURITY INSTRUMENTS OR UNDER ANY AMENDMENT, SUPPLEMENT, INSTRUMENT, DOCUMENT OR AGREEMENT DELIVERED (OR WHICH MAY IN THE FUTURE BE DELIVERED) IN CONNECTION HEREWITH OR ARISING FROM ANY BANKING RELATIONSHIP EXISTING IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT. THE BORROWER AGREES THAT ANY SUCH ACTION OR PROCEEDING SHALL BE TRIED BEFORE A COURT AND NOT BEFORE A JURY.
clauses.plain_english: The borrower gives up the right to have a jury decide any lawsuit related to the loan agreement; any disputes will be decided by a judge alone.
clauses.risk_justification: Waiver of jury trial is a common but one-sided provision in commercial loan agreements; it limits the borrower's constitutional right but is generally enforceable and not extreme.
obligations: Borrower waives right to jury trial
Borrower agrees that any action shall be tried before a court
rights: Lender may enforce disputes in court without a jury

clauses.heading: 17. Governing Law. The Loan Agreement (including the First Amendm
clauses.text: ent) shall be deemed to have been made or incurred under the Laws of the State of Oklahoma and shall be construed and enforced in accordance with and governed by the Laws of Oklahoma.
clauses.plain_english: This clause states that the agreement will be interpreted and enforced according to the laws of the State of Oklahoma.
clauses.risk_justification: Standard choice-of-law provision that is mutual, balanced, and poses no unusual exposure or liability.
obligations: Interpret and enforce the agreement in accordance with Oklahoma law

clauses.heading: 18. Release. In consideration of the amendments contained herein,
clauses.text: Borrower hereby waives and releases Bank from any and all claims and defenses, known or unknown, as of the effective date of this First Amendment, with respect to the Loan Agreement (including this First Amendment) and the Loan Documents and the transactions contemplated thereby.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower gives up any right to sue or raise defenses against the Bank regarding the loan agreement and related documents as of the date of this amendment.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause waives all known and unknown claims, which is broad and exposes the Borrower to losing potential claims without a reciprocal release from the Bank. However, such releases are common in loan amendments and are limited to the loan agreement context, reducing extremity.
obligations: Borrower shall not assert any claims or defenses against Bank relating to the Loan Agreement, Loan Documents, or transactions contemplated thereby.
rights: Bank is released from any claims or defenses by Borrower relating to the Loan Agreement, Loan Documents, or transactions contemplated thereby.
